evals.name: comprehensive-outlook-poll
evals.prompt: Check the news for a comprehensive outlook — US, China, Singapore, markets, and important world news. What's new since yesterday?
evals.expected_output: Clustered markdown poll covering all 5 categories (us, china, singapore, markets, important), each story with title + URL + score, cross-feed dedup visible as '(also: ...)', no errors

evals.name: singapore-focus
evals.prompt: Just Singapore news today please — local news and SG market news. Nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Poll scoped to the singapore category only: local sources (CNA, Straits Times, Business Times, Google News SG), no other category sections

evals.name: json-contract-poll
evals.prompt: Poll all feeds and give me the raw JSON output, don't summarize it.
evals.expected_output: Strict JSON following the skill's contract: count, results with per-category clusters (cluster_id, score, matched_keywords, other_sources, items), errors array
